test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 09
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term.

BDGK: CEHL :: ???? : DFIM
solution:
Given,

BDGK: CEHL :: ???? : DFIM

According to the English Alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82b5cb85d0e7994c9b0fc08be61b1f658d8c5b56d8b9326c245239452d782bc1.png] 

The pattern followed here is the next letter in alphabetical order of letters in the first word is written in the second word.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd317634505f7a4ea359e0c75c37f952a662f9904f4ae9370d6bdf41a187f36e.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cf39a4e0d890b6f6c73c41f895995705ec627bc44a85e341e68eac87009b38b.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is CEHL.**
